title: bind highlights in gpu preview

commit.merge_subject: merge: bind highlights in gpu preview

tests: seam-frame test passes highlights = -55f and asserts the raw value
description:
The export develop session got stage 15 (highlights) in 0efcc75, but
the GPU PREVIEW session silently skipped it: PreviewFrameRequest had no
highlights field, so uHighlights rode the GLSL 0.0 default and the
editor preview understated highlights on GPU whenever the grade used
the slider. The eligibility gate already treats stage 15 as
fragment-covered (0efcc75 moved 15 into the covered set), so a
highlights grade was GPU-eligible yet rendered with the control
dropped — the exact silent-skip shape the stage-15 export port closed
on the develop seam.

This mirrors the 0efcc75 export-side threading on the preview path,
end to end:

- GlesPreviewSession.h: PreviewFrameRequest gains `highlights` (raw
  grade.highlights; the shader computes s) after exposureEv; the color
  contract comment now counts 17 uniforms / five covered controls.
- GlesPreviewSession.cpp: highlightsLoc member beside exp
changed: feat: bind stage 15 highlights in gpu preview
